summary: Christine Isakson, 49, of Highlands Ranch, summited Mt. Shavano and Mt. Tabeguache, then descended the wrong gulch (McCoy Gulch) off Tabeguache, mistaking her position relative to the Jennings Creek trail; out of water at nightfall, she called 911 around 4:30 p.m., and a Chaffee County Search and Rescue South team reached her shortly after dark and guided her out of the gulch by 11 p.m., uninjured.
responding_agency: Chaffee County Search and Rescue South
notes: Run 995 Mountain Mail chunk: Mountain Mail article on two Tabeguache incidents Sunday and Monday; article record dated 2017-09-08 pins the Sunday to 2017-09-03; same article as the 2017-09-04 Hunsaker rescue.
